findings.explanation: The endpoint does not verify that the user deleting the account is either the owner of the account or an administrator, violating the policy rule 'A user may read or update ONLY their own profile'. The code only checks if the user exists and deletes it without verifying ownership.

evidence.content: - A user may read or update ONLY their own profile (`/users/<id>`). Administrators may read or update any profile. Use `is_owner_or_admin(current_user, user_id)` for this check.

findings.suggested_fix: Add a check to ensure the current user is either the owner of the account or an administrator before deleting it.
